sources.title: Nyanta19/tesda-e5-small-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The matching model for TESDA-TRACK. It is a fine-tune of intfloat/multilingual-e5-small that matches learner goals, written in English, Filipino or Taglish, to TESDA qualifications. The repo contains the ONNX model only, with no PyTorch weights. The TESDA-TRACK API runs it on CPU through fastembed ...
